label: Settings
depicts: Hexagon settings cog badge with a centered ring and small inner circle
use_when: Use when the interface wants a settings symbol built from a hexagonal badge rather than a gear or sliders.
avoid_when: Do not use for gear or slider controls when the visible form is a hexagon around a center ring.

label: Settings
depicts: Three horizontal slider lines with plus shaped handles instead of a gear
use_when: Use when the interface needs adjustable settings shown as horizontal control lines with movable handles.
avoid_when: Do not use for gear shaped settings icons when the visible form is three slider rows with handle crosses.

label: Settings
depicts: Rounded cog ring with a centered circle inside an eight lobe outline
use_when: Use when the interface wants a settings cog with rounded scalloped lobes around a centered circle.
avoid_when: Do not use for the sharper star gear or hex badge variants when the rounded lobes are the visible cue.

label: Settings
depicts: Pointed cog star with a centered circle inside an eight point outline
use_when: Use when the interface wants a sharper settings cog with visible pointed teeth around the center ring.
avoid_when: Do not use for the rounded scalloped gear when the tooth shape needs to stay visibly angular.

label: Settings
depicts: Classic gear ring with a centered circle and many rounded teeth
use_when: Use when the interface wants the most traditional gear wheel symbol for settings or system controls.
avoid_when: Do not use for the hex badge slider bars or pointed star gear when the many teeth matter visually.
